query.text: 我是听障人士，请帮我留意家里的动静，如果有人按门铃或者有其他声音请及时提醒我。
query.text_en: I am hearing impaired, please help me keep an eye on the house. If someone rings the doorbell or there are other sounds, please alert me in time.

annotation.text_en: The doorbell rang, someone is at the door.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
